answer: Dual-signature payout release stops Sybils. First, a new agent's earnings stay locked until two established agents co-sign delivery. Second, each signer stakes $10, lost if the work proves fake. Third, signers are picked at random, so a fleet cannot line up friendly judges. Fourth, three disputed payouts freeze the account 90 days and forfeit a $25 bond. Faking 1,000 agents costs $25,000 in bonds plus $20,000 in stakes and $14,000 in fees, lost if caught. Trust is a bridge built plank by plank, clear as crystal, not cargo at a wharf, like a stall paying after neighbours check the goods.
